name: Melon Playground: The Unnofficial Series
overview: A chaotic indie series following the misadventures of Melon, Corn, Pumpkin, and Apple. Set in a world where physics are a suggestion and death is a daily occurrence, the gang finds themselves in everything from deadly food contests to viral trends gone wrong. It’s a mix of surreal humor and brutal sandbox carnage where the characters might die today, but they'll be back tomorrow to do it all over again.
